# Migration-Readiness Requirements Quality Checklist: Bootstrap & Cleanup — MUI Migration Phase 0

**Purpose**: Validate that all requirements for Phase 0 (dependency cleanup, dead code removal, MUI theme setup) are complete, unambiguous, and measurable before implementation planning
**Created**: 2026-05-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items validate requirement quality, not implementation correctness.

[Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014] — **PASS**: FR-014 specifies MUI/Emotion. Other kept deps retain existing pinned versions in package.json (motion 12.23.24, lucide-react 0.487.0, date-fns 3.6.0). No change needed.
- [x] CHK003 - Is the exhaustive list of files in src/styles/ documented in the spec, or does FR-006 rely on implementation-time discovery? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006] — **PASS**: FR-006 lists 5 files (tailwind.css, globals.css, theme.css, fonts.css, index.css). Audit confirms exactly 5 files exist. Complete match.
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for handling the `pnpm` field in package.json's `overrides` section, or only pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — **RESOLVED**: Added to FR-001 and FR-005 — the `pnpm` overrides field MUST be removed.
- [x] CHK005 - Is the expected `packageManager` field value in package.json specified (e.g., `yarn@4.9.2`), or is "Yarn Berry v4+" sufficient? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — **RESOLVED**: Updated FR-001 to specify `packageManager` field must be set to latest stable Yarn Berry (e.g., `yarn@4.9.2`).
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements for tsconfig.node.json (companion to tsconfig.json) defined, or is only tsconfig.json addressed in FR-015? [Gap, Spec §FR-015] — **RESOLVED**: Updated FR-015 to include tsconfig.node.json requirement.
- [x] CHK007 - Is the `typecheck` script expected in package.json specified as a requirement, or is it an implementation detail? [Completeness, Gap] — **PASS**: Implementation detail. The scripts section of package.json is not in scope for requirements — it's a plan-level decision.
- [x] CHK008 - Are peerDependencies and peerDependenciesMeta requirements for react/react-dom defined, or is this left to implementation discretion? [Gap] — **RESOLVED**: Updated FR-011 to specify react/react-dom remain as peerDependencies with `optional: true`.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 - Is "exactly 9 production dependencies" in SC-001 precise about what counts (e.g., does React itself count, or only non-React deps)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001] — **RESOLVED**: Updated SC-001 to clarify: 7 production deps + react/react-dom as peerDeps + devDependencies.
- [x] CHK010 - Is the phrase "dark emerald/gold palette" in FR-007 quantified with exact hex values for ALL palette entries (primary, secondary, error, background, text)? Remaining palette entries (secondary, error, divider) are implementation-level decisions for the plan phase.
- [x] CHK011 - Is "Emotion cache" in FR-008 clarified — does ThemeProviderWrapper need an explicit Emotion CacheProvider, or does MUI v7 handle this internally? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008] — **RESOLVED**: Updated FR-008 to clarify no explicit Emotion CacheProvider needed — MUI v7 auto-manages.
- [x] CHK012 - Is the expected behavior of `yarn build` after cleanup clearly defined: should it exit 0 (with errors), exit non-zero, or is only "no Vite plugin errors" the bar? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006] — **PASS**: The Assumptions section explicitly states "The Vite build WILL produce TypeScript errors after this phase — this is acceptable and expected." SC-006 focuses on Vite dev server, not build. Clarification Q4 confirms broken build is intentional.
- [x] CHK013 - Is the scope of "dead files" in FR-006 exhaustive, or could there be other dead files (e.g., in root, guidelines/, etc.) not listed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006] — **PASS**: FR-006 explicitly lists the 4 dead files by name. Other files (guidelines/, ATTRIBUTIONS.md) are not dead code — they're active project documentation.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 - Is SC-001 ("exactly 9 production dependencies") consistent with FR-011 ("keep these dependencies" listing 7 packages) — are the 2 missing ones react and react-dom as peer dependencies? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §FR-011] — **RESOLVED**: Updated SC-001 and FR-011. Now consistent: 7 production deps + react/react-dom as peers.
- [x] CHK016 - Is FR-006 (delete src/styles/) consistent with the clarification about main.tsx — does FR-009 (update main.tsx to wrap in ThemeProviderWrapper) also cover removing the CSS import, or is that implicit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009] — **RESOLVED**: Updated FR-009 to explicitly state "remove the `import "./styles/index.css"` CSS import".
- [x] CHK017 - Does FR-010 (remove Tailwind CSS plugin) align with FR-012 (keep figmaAssetResolver) — are these the ONLY two plugins in vite.config.ts, or could there be others? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012] — **PASS**: Audit confirms exactly 3 plugins: figmaAssetResolver(), react(), tailwindcss(). FR-010 says remove tailwindcss(), FR-012 says keep figmaAssetResolver(). The react() plugin is implicitly kept by FR-010 ("keeping both @vitejs/plugin-react and figmaAssetResolver()"). Consistent.
- [x] CHK018 - Is the Edge Case about "CSS custom properties defined in theme.css" consistent with FR-006 (delete all of src/styles/) — are there any CSS custom properties used outside src/styles/ that need handling? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006] — **PASS**: Audit shows CSS custom properties are only defined in theme.css (inside src/styles/) and default_shadcn_theme.css (also deleted). No component files reference `var(--*)` from these files — they use Tailwind classes directly. No conflict.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 - Is SC-004 ("MUI theme renders with correct dark palette") measurable without a running browser, or does it require manual DevTools inspection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — **PASS**: The "Independent Test" for User Story 2 specifies: "importing the theme in a test file and verifying the palette contains the correct colors (primary: #D4AF37 gold, background: #0a1f0a dark emerald)". This is measurable via a Node.js import + assertion, no browser needed.
- [x] CHK020 - Is SC-006 ("Vite dev server starts without plugin errors") objectively verifiable, or is "plugin errors" ambiguous — does it mean zero console warnings or zero fatal errors? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006] — **PASS**: In context, "plugin errors" means the Vite plugin system doesn't throw when loading config. This is objectively verifiable by `yarn dev` starting without exit/crash. Warnings are acceptable.
- [x] CHK021 - Can SC-003 ("zero .tsx files in src/app/components/ui/") be verified with a single command, or does it also need to account for subdirectories or non-.tsx files? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] — **PASS**: The entire directory is deleted (FR-003: "entire src/app/components/ui/ directory deleted"). Verification is `ls src/app/components/ui/` → "No such file or directory". No subdirectories exist.
- [x] CHK022 - Are the acceptance scenarios in User Story 1 (3 scenarios) traceable to specific FRs, or are they free-standing without requirement linkage? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 1] — **PASS**: Scenario 1 → FR-001 (yarn), Scenario 2 → FR-003+FR-004 (shadcn+radix removal), Scenario 3 → FR-002+FR-010 (Tailwind removal). Each scenario maps to specific FRs.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where `node_modules/` doesn't exist yet (first-time clone) — is `yarn install` expected to work from scratch? [Coverage, Gap] — **PASS**: SC-002 covers this: "Running `yarn install` completes without errors and generates a valid yarn.lock". First-time clone is the primary use case for `yarn install`.
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a developer has uncommitted changes when running the cleanup — should there be a warning or stash requirement? [Coverage, Edge Case] — **PASS**: Out of scope. Phase 0 is a single atomic operation on a feature branch. Uncommitted changes management is a git workflow concern, not a spec requirement.
- [x] CHK025 - Is there a requirement for git commit strategy — should Phase 0 be a single atomic commit or multiple commits per group (A–I)? [Coverage, Gap] — **PASS**: Implementation detail for the plan phase. The spec defines WHAT to do, not HOW to commit. Single atomic commit is a plan-level decision.
- [x] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for what happens to existing TypeScript errors in component files that reference deleted imports — is the error message quality a concern? [Coverage, Edge Case] — **PASS**: Covered by Assumptions: "The application components will not compile after this phase... this is intentionally a clean slate phase." Error message quality is not a concern — errors are expected.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 - Is the scenario where pnpm-lock.yaml does NOT exist (only pnpm-workspace.yaml) explicitly addressed as a requirement, or only as a clarification answer? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications Q7] — **PASS**: Clarification Q7 resolved this: "If it exists, delete it. If not (only pnpm-workspace.yaml), delete the workspace file only." Audit confirms pnpm-lock.yaml does NOT exist, only pnpm-workspace.yaml. FR-001 covers "no pnpm artifacts".
- [x] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for .gitignore entries that may already exist vs. need to be appended — is duplicate entry prevention specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016] — **PASS**: Implementation detail. `gitignore` appends are idempotent — duplicate entries don't cause issues. FR-016 specifies WHAT entries to add, not HOW to add them.
- [x] CHK029 - Is the scenario where tsconfig.json already exists (but may not have strict: true) covered by FR-015, or does it only say "create if missing"? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015] — **PASS**: FR-015 says "create if missing, verify if existing". The "verify if existing" branch covers this scenario — if it exists, ensure `strict: true` is set. Audit confirms tsconfig.json does NOT exist, so the "create" branch applies.
- [x] CHK030 - Is the scenario where src/app/components/figma/ImageWithFallback.tsx uses Tailwind classes addressed — the Assumptions say keep it, but does FR-006 conflict? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-006] — **RESOLVED**: Updated Assumptions to note ImageWithFallback.tsx uses Tailwind classes (inline-block, bg-gray-100, flex, etc.) and will break — migration deferred to Spec 002. No conflict with FR-006 (which only deletes src/styles/, not component files).

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK031 - Are performance requirements for `yarn install` time defined (e.g., should complete in under 60 seconds), or is SC-002 ("completes without errors") sufficient? [NFR, Spec §SC-002] — **PASS**: SC-002 ("completes without errors") is sufficient. Install time is environment-dependent and not a concern for a kiosk display that installs once.
- [x] CHK032 - Are accessibility requirements for the MUI theme specified (e.g., color contrast ratios for gold on dark emerald), or is that deferred to a later spec? [NFR, Gap] — **PASS**: Deferred to Spec 006 (polish-theme-system). Phase 0 establishes the theme foundation; accessibility validation happens when components are migrated.
- [x] CHK033 - Is a bundle size target after cleanup defined as a requirement, or is SC-001's dependency count the only size proxy? [NFR, Spec §SC-001] — **PASS**: Constitution Article IV states "Bundle size is a first-class concern — target < 500KB gzipped." This is a project-level NFR, not spec-specific. Dependency count (SC-001) is the Phase 0 proxy.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK034 - Is the assumption that "no app component imports from components/ui/" verified as a requirement, or is it an unvalidated assumption that could cause runtime issues? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — **PASS**: Verified by audit. Zero files outside `src/app/components/ui/` import from `components/ui/`, `@radix-ui/*`, `clsx`, or `tailwind-merge`. The assumption is validated.
- [x] CHK035 - Is the dependency on Spec 002 (component migration) for a working app clearly documented as a blocker, or could Phase 0 be misinterpreted as producing a functional app? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions] — **PASS**: Explicitly stated in Assumptions: "The application components will not compile after this phase... The app will not be functional until Spec 002 migrates components to MUI." Also in Edge Cases and Clarification Q4.
- [x] CHK036 - Is the Node.js version requirement specified (e.g., 18+), or is this an implicit assumption? [Assumption, Gap] — **PASS**: Implicit but reasonable. Vite 6.x requires Node 18+. The constitution's Technology Stack section and Vite's own requirements establish this. Not a spec-level concern.
